moves.name:
Alola
Analysis
moves.description: Increases the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="7" ] of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="8" ] [EN:Qty Ref="8" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Applies [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="9" ] to the allied field of play. [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="9" ] grants all of the following effects: Powers up the special attack moves and special sync moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces special attack move and special sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ]%. The more sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]% and reduces damage by [Digit:1digit Idx="4" ]%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="5" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="6" ]%.)

moves.name:
Nihil
Meteor Beam
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="4" ] is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="4" ] is not raised.

The user gets ready to attack. Raises the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when it gets ready to attack. (The user’s Sp. Atk will not rise if it has not gotten ready to attack.) Using this move again will cause the user to leave this posture, then attack. No other actions can be taken while ready to attack. Never misses. The more the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] is lowered, the greater the power of this attack. Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when it is poisoned or badly poisoned. The preparation period is skipped when a circle applies to the allied field of play, and the user will attack right away.
